activities.name: Paro Tsechu
activities.note: the dates follow the Bhutanese lunar calendar, so they move year to year — check the published calendar before booking

windows.reason: a five-day festival in spring, including the dawn unfurling of the giant silk thongdrel

activities.name: Thimphu Tsechu
activities.note: the largest of Bhutan's festivals, held at Tashichho Dzong; the lunar date moves each year

windows.reason: held in September or October, and the biggest gathering in the Bhutanese festival calendar

activities.name: Black-necked cranes in the Phobjikha Valley
activities.note: the cranes spend the summer breeding on the Tibetan Plateau

windows.reason: the cranes winter in the valley, and the Black-necked Crane Festival is held on 12 November to welcome them
they arrive in late October and leave by mid-February

activities.name: Punakha Drubchen and Tshechu
activities.note: the festival starts on the ninth day of the first Bhutanese month, so its dates move each year

windows.reason: held at Punakha Dzong in February or March, with the Drubchen in the days just before the Tshechu
